text: can we also get a normalize under a specific size threshold so that it doesnt take what is a larger uv surface and make it the same as a sliver
resolution: Added an editable MAX NORMALIZE AREA gate to the repeated-UV dry run. Normalize now measures each congruent island by summed authored-triangle UV area, admits only surfaces at or below the threshold (default 4,096 px²), selects the largest eligible footprint, and reports larger matches as protected. Exact Scale remains unrestricted. If fewer than two eligible members remain, no stack is proposed. Focused topology tests cover a protected broad surface, eligible small copies, and the one-sliver no-op case; the ReleaseFast editor build passes.
